additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Please follow the steps provided in the attached document and refer to the points below:
Check the areas marked in red for possible loose wiring.
Examine the Fast Shutdown Wiring
: Check he wiring connected to the fast shutdown.
Check KF13 Voltage Output:
Check if the KF13 is sending a steady 12VDC output as required.
Verifie QA (contactors) Switch Functionality
: After confirming that the KF13 was sending 12V, check whether the QAs are closing correctly.
Check Terminal Connections:
Inspect the connection on the +F03-XD6 terminal.
Verify the connections on XD9.2A/B and XD14.1A/B.
Ensure proper connections on +F03 XD5 for the 12VDC supply.
(Note: Refer KF14 as KF13
)
If all the wiring is secure and configuration is ok, then need to be replace but check all the connections of the KF14 module before considering its replacement.
MLFB NO. A 8EM5903-0AA03-2AA6 -KF14 Statemonitor Lite 2x CCS 1x AC
Additionally, please refer to the attached knowledge article links for your reference.
